subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Gateway-owned external-conversation API and v11 agent-database model as the permanent core boundary distinct from local sessions?
rationale: The branch adds owner-only model tools, cross-client Gateway RPCs, Plugin SDK delivery semantics, and persisted state; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the long-term product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Adopt the conversation boundary
options.body: Accept the API and storage direction after live Reef, restart, and v10-upgrade proof confirms the intended behavior.

options.title: Narrow to Reef first
options.body: Keep the generic contract private or experimental and land only a Reef-specific loop and correlation repair while the cross-channel API is designed separately.

options.title: Retain existing tools
options.body: Reject the new permanent surface and address the Reef failure through explicit message targets and narrower session safeguards.

recommendation.title: Adopt the conversation boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the API and storage direction after live Reef, restart, and v10-upgrade proof confirms the intended behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the linked design and branch and has the strongest adjacent agent-runtime ownership signal.
